adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it unconditionally calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The loading template reloads the page every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb), which will re-hit `#best` and enqueue again as long as the embed isn’t created yet. While the job’s `TopicRetriever#retrieve` has a Redis throttle (`retrieved_recently?`) to avoid repeated fetching, there is no dedup/throttle at enqueue time in the controller, so a busy embedded page can still generate many queued jobs.
